left_ventricle.label: Left ventricle
left_ventricle.description: Pumps oxygen-rich blood through the aortic valve to the whole body. Its wall is the thickest in the heart.

right_ventricle.label: Right ventricle
right_ventricle.description: Pumps oxygen-poor blood through the pulmonary valve to the lungs.

right_atrium.label: Right atrium
right_atrium.description: Collects oxygen-poor blood from the body through the venae cavae.

right_auricle.label: Right auricle
right_auricle.description: A small ear-shaped pouch of the right atrium.

left_atrium.label: Left atrium
left_atrium.description: Collects oxygen-rich blood from the lungs through the pulmonary veins.

left_auricle.label: Left auricle
left_auricle.description: A small ear-shaped pouch of the left atrium.

ascending_aorta.label: Ascending aorta
ascending_aorta.description: Carries blood up from the left ventricle. The coronary arteries branch from its root.

aortic_arch.label: Aortic arch
aortic_arch.description: Curves over the pulmonary arteries and sends branches to the head and arms.

descending_aorta.label: Descending aorta
descending_aorta.description: Carries blood down to the chest and abdomen.

brachiocephalic_trunk.label: Brachiocephalic trunk
brachiocephalic_trunk.description: First branch of the arch. Supplies the right arm, head and neck.

left_common_carotid.label: Left common carotid artery
left_common_carotid.description: Supplies the left side of the head and neck.

pulmonary_trunk.label: Pulmonary trunk
pulmonary_trunk.description: Carries oxygen-poor blood from the right ventricle towards the lungs.

left_pulmonary_artery.label: Left pulmonary artery
left_pulmonary_artery.description: Carries oxygen-poor blood to the left lung.

right_pulmonary_artery.label: Right pulmonary artery
right_pulmonary_artery.description: Carries oxygen-poor blood to the right lung, passing behind the aorta.

superior_vena_cava.label: Superior vena cava
superior_vena_cava.description: Returns blood from the head, neck and arms to the right atrium.

inferior_vena_cava.label: Inferior vena cava
inferior_vena_cava.description: Returns blood from the lower body to the right atrium.

pv_left_superior.label: Left superior pulmonary vein
pv_left_superior.description: Brings oxygen-rich blood from the left lung to the left atrium.

pv_left_inferior.label: Left inferior pulmonary vein
pv_left_inferior.description: Brings oxygen-rich blood from the left lung to the left atrium.

pv_right_superior.label: Right superior pulmonary vein
pv_right_superior.description: Brings oxygen-rich blood from the right lung to the left atrium.

pv_right_inferior.label: Right inferior pulmonary vein
pv_right_inferior.description: Brings oxygen-rich blood from the right lung to the left atrium.

papillary_muscle_anterolateral.label: Papillary muscle (anterolateral)
papillary_muscle_anterolateral.description: Pulls on the chordae so the mitral valve does not flip back into the atrium.

papillary_muscle_posteromedial.label: Papillary muscle (posteromedial)
papillary_muscle_posteromedial.description: Pulls on the chordae so the mitral valve does not flip back into the atrium.

papillary_muscle_right_anterior.label: Papillary muscle (right anterior)
papillary_muscle_right_anterior.description: Anchors the tricuspid valve through its chordae.

papillary_muscle_right_posterior.label: Papillary muscle (right posterior)
papillary_muscle_right_posterior.description: Anchors the tricuspid valve through its chordae.

left_main_coronary_artery.label: Left main coronary artery
left_main_coronary_artery.description: Short trunk from the aorta that splits into the anterior descending and circumflex arteries.

left_anterior_descending_artery.label: Left anterior descending artery
left_anterior_descending_artery.description: Runs down the front groove. Feeds the front of the heart and most of the septum.

diagonal_branch.label: Diagonal branch
diagonal_branch.description: A branch of the anterior descending artery over the left ventricle.

anterior_interventricular_vein.label: Anterior interventricular vein
anterior_interventricular_vein.description: Drains the front of the heart, beside the anterior descending artery.

left_circumflex_artery.label: Left circumflex artery
left_circumflex_artery.description: Curves round the left side in the groove between atrium and ventricle.

great_cardiac_vein_and_coronary_sinus.label: Great cardiac vein and coronary sinus
great_cardiac_vein_and_coronary_sinus.description: Collects blood from the heart muscle and empties it into the right atrium.

posterior_descending_artery.label: Posterior descending artery
posterior_descending_artery.description: Runs down the back groove between the ventricles.

right_coronary_artery.label: Right coronary artery
right_coronary_artery.description: Runs round the right side in the groove between atrium and ventricle.

middle_cardiac_vein.label: Middle cardiac vein
middle_cardiac_vein.description: Drains the back of the ventricles, beside the posterior descending artery.

valves.name: mitral_valve
valves.label: Mitral valve
valves.description: Two leaflets between the left atrium and left ventricle. Open while the ventricle fills.

valves.name: tricuspid_valve
valves.label: Tricuspid valve
valves.description: Three leaflets between the right atrium and right ventricle. Open while the ventricle fills.

valves.name: aortic_valve
valves.label: Aortic valve
valves.description: Three cusps at the root of the aorta. Open while the left ventricle pumps.

valves.name: pulmonary_valve
valves.label: Pulmonary valve
valves.description: Three cusps at the root of the pulmonary trunk. Open while the right ventricle pumps.

chordae.label: Chordae tendineae
chordae.description: Heart strings that tie the valve leaflets to the papillary muscles.
